messages.content: Native Eliza Stage 1 authority regression fixture. Follow the HANDLE_RESPONSE contract.
Reply with the exact token ELIZA_GATEWAY_CANARY_OK.

function.description: Stage 1: populate registered response-handler fields once before action tools. Empty values for non-applicable fields.
function.name: HANDLE_RESPONSE

addressedTo.description: Addressee entity UUIDs preferred; display names ok.

candidateActionNames.description: Action names. UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Retrieval hints; high-precision hits expose planner actions.

contexts.description: Context ids from available_contexts. 'simple'=direct reply, no planner.

emotion.description: User emotion. "none"=no strong cue/default. Other values map to omnivoice expressive tags.

facts.description: Plain-English facts. One per item. Prefer subject-predicate-object.

intents.description: Verb-led intents. Lowercase. No punctuation. ~6 words max.

relationships.description: Semantic relationships between entities. Empty array if none stated.

predicate.description: Relation type. Lowercase verb phrase: works_with, is_friend_of, owns, lives_in.

subject.description: Relationship subject: user name, entity name, 'user', or 'agent'.

replyText.description: User-facing reply. Simple=whole answer. Planning=brief ack ("On it.", "Working on it.", "Spawning a sub-agent now."). Never refuse on planning path. Plain text unless channel supports markdown.

shouldRespond.description: RESPOND=reply/run actions. IGNORE=silent. STOP=explicit user stop.

topics.description: Short topic labels. Lowercase. 1-3 words each. Nouns/noun-phrases, not verbs. Max 5.
